A '''zoom magnifier'''<ref name="SWS" /> or '''zoom imager'''<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. It was a a standard piece of equipment installed on [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]].<ref name="SWS" />
